recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the published Jira disposition and later editor clarification with a narrow source fix in an active example, while preserving the intended example binding strength.
issue_request: FHIR-34129 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. It requested an example showing repeated Dosage.doseAndRate for "1800 mg (1000 mg/m2) orally twice daily from days 1-14 of cycle" and asked whether dose-rate-type should become required; the final resolution was to add the example but leave the binding as example because other implementer codes may be needed.
initial_application: Commit 7482aeda78 added medicationrequestexample3 and linked it from the MedicationRequest example indexes. Commit c0a117e508 attempted to address the Jira correction that 1800 should be calculated and 1000 should be ordered, but it swapped only numeric values and left mg/m2 attached to 1800 and mg attached to 1000.
additional_context: MedicationRequest and Dosage are active build inputs in source/fhir.ini, and medicationrequestexample3 is linked from the active MedicationRequest examples list. The current Dosage spreadsheet still binds DoseAndRateType with example strength, matching the Jira resolution not to require the value set. Zulip follow-up on the same example explicitly confirmed that the units remained backwards and should be ordered 1000 mg/m2 and calculated 1800 mg.
reconciliation: Changed source/medicationrequest/medicationrequestexample3.xml so the calculated doseAndRate carries 1800 mg and the ordered doseAndRate carries 1000 mg/m2. No binding change was made.
source_changes: source/medicationrequest/medicationrequestexample3.xml: changed the calculated doseQuantity unit/code from mg/m2 to mg for value 1800.
source/medicationrequest/medicationrequestexample3.xml: changed the ordered doseQuantity unit/code from mg to mg/m2 for value 1000.
